signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Feature Ownership : Own the definition and delivery of discrete features or workflows within a larger platform roadmap, from requirements through launch.
Execution Support : Break down roadmap priorities into clear, sequenced work; write specs and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can build against.
Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner day-to-day with engineering, design, and data to unblock delivery and ensure quality.
Data & Feedback : Track launch metrics and user feedback; use them to inform iteration and surface issues early.
Stakeholder Communication : Keep your PM lead and cross-functional partners informed on status, risks, and trade-offs.
